contest.measure_text: To protect the quality of education in local schools and continue funding for math, science, technology, engineering, arts, skilled trades, and advanced programs that prepare students for success in college/careers; attracting and retaining highly qualified teachers; and maintaining manageable class sizes, shall Las Virgenes Unified School District's measure renewing the existing school parcel tax at the current $98 rate (no increase) for twelve years be adopted, with senior exemptions and all funds ($2,000,000 annually) benefiting local students? Supporters: Richard Sherman, CPHOA Pres.; Karen Zak Kent, DDS; Dr. Kirk Tamaddon, LVUSD Oversight Comm.; Joe Seetoo, CFA; Angie Falk Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: LAS VIRGENES UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT SPECIAL ELECTION - MEASURE LV
